Vizard vs VEXI: AI Video Clipper and AI Content Studio
Vizard and VEXI, side by side: what each one does and what it costs, from each company's own pages.

Vizard turns long videos into short clips for TikTok, Instagram and YouTube Shorts, and its AI agent makes videos from templates [1]. VEXI makes and posts your social content. They overlap on short video, and in many ways they fit together.

Vizard uses AI to turn long-form videos into short clips for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts and more [1]. Its editor trims a clip when you delete words from its transcript, translates captions and resizes for each platform, and its plans include auto-subtitling and auto B-roll [1][2]. Its newer AI agent makes videos from templates such as product ads, talking heads, explainers and podcast clips [1]. Clips can be downloaded, shared as links or published directly from Vizard, and its Creator and Business plans schedule social posts [1][2]. Vizard’s no-cost plan has 60 credits a month; Creator and Business are sold by credits [2].

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.

Credit where it is due: Vizard finds the strongest moments in a long recording, clips them and posts them [1]. VEXI starts from a photo, a clip, a link or nothing at all, also designs posts and carousels, and Autopilot runs your week ahead. What you pay for is the work you no longer do.
Vizard makes video: AI clips from your long recordings, and videos its AI agent makes from templates such as product ads, explainers and photo stories [1].
VEXI designs the post with your logo, colors, fonts and voice. Tap anything on the design to change it.
Vizard publishes directly to your social accounts, and its Creator and Business plans schedule social posts across 6 or 20 accounts [1][2].
VEXI Autopilot runs your week ahead: it writes, cuts and posts, and can wait for your approval on everything.

Turns long recordings into captioned short clips and publishes or schedules them, and its AI agent makes new videos from templates [1][2].
One app: you ask, and it writes, designs, edits the video and posts it. Autopilot runs your week ahead.

Vizard turns long videos, such as podcasts, webinars and interviews, into short clips with auto-subtitles and B-roll, and lets you trim a clip by editing its transcript [1][2]. Its AI agent makes videos from templates such as product ads and explainers [1]. VEXI turns a long recording into its best clips too, and starts from a photo, a link or nothing at all.
Does Vizard post to social media?

Yes. Vizard publishes directly to social media, and its Creator and Business plans schedule social posts [1][2]. VEXI posts to Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads and your Google Business Profile, on a schedule or on Autopilot.

Vizard’s no-cost plan has 60 credits a month, and Creator and Business are sold by credits [2]. Their prices did not show on Vizard’s pricing page when we read it on 2026-11-20, so check that page before you buy [2].
